GROUP WILL RETURN TO ATLANTA VIA GREYHOUND ARRIVING 8 AM, JANUARY 16 NEXT. ARRANGEMENTS MADE BY INFORMANT THROUGH MRS. NANCY COLLINSON, ATLANTA, GEORGIA. INFORMANT WILL BE COMPENSATED UP TO $100 FOR TRANSPORTATION AND EXPENSES ON SAC AUTHORITY. INFORMANT BEING USED IN THIS INSTANCE AS MEANS OF ACQUAINTING HERSELF WITH PERSONS ACTIVE IN VIETNAM ACTIVITIES AND RACIAL ACTIVITIES AND FOR PURPOSE OF REPORTING PERTINENT INFORMATION REGARDING ACTIVITIES OF THIS GROUP IN WASHINGTON, D.C.<br/><br/>PHILIP MORRIS WO<br/><br/>2 CC WASHINGTON FIELD.<br/><br/>JAN 16 1968<br/><br/><br/><i>If the intelligence contained in the above message is to be disseminated outside the Bureau, it is suggested that it be suitably NWD 88421 pDocID 32189545 page 06 Bureau's cryptographic systems.</i></td></tr></tbody></table>
